name: Farsen's Watch
summary: High above Gol'Bolar Quarry, Earthseer Farsen watches for Dark Iron movement in Dun Morogh. The visiting Wildhammer shaman uses farsight to reveal their growing infiltration near Ironforge, beginning a path toward the Hall of Thanes.

sections.title: Eyes Across the Ridge
sections.body: Earthseer Farsen keeps a vigilant watch over the lower reaches of Dun Morogh from above Gol'Bolar Quarry. He journeyed south from the crags of Aerie Peak, bringing a Wildhammer's spiritual awareness to lands usually patrolled by Ironforge mountaineers. Farsen uses his clan's traditional arts to sense subterranean rumblings and watch for unexpected movement along the hillsides.

sections.title: A Borrowed Vision
sections.body: Farsen lends travelers his farsight, a shamanic gift that carries awareness across great distances. Through this vision, you see that Dun Morogh's troubles reach beyond troggs and wild beasts. Dark Iron dwarves have slipped close to Ironforge's industrial center and are entrenching themselves for an operation that demands immediate confrontation before it takes root.

faq.answer: Earthseer Farsen is a Wildhammer dwarf visiting Dun Morogh from Aerie Peak in the Hinterlands. His shamanic magic lets him sense disturbances in the land and observe threats from afar.

faq.q: Where is this watch taking place?
faq.answer: Farsen watches from above Gol'Bolar Quarry, a Bronzebeard mining excavation in eastern Dun Morogh.
Farsen's farsight reveals a nearby foothold of hostile Dark Iron dwarves, an active danger to the region.

faq.q: How does this connect to the Hall of Thanes?
faq.answer: Investigating the Dark Iron presence seen during Farsen's watch begins the chain of tasks for those seeking entry to the Hall of Thanes.

faq.q: Why is a Wildhammer dwarf involved in Dun Morogh's defense?
faq.answer: Wildhammers call the Hinterlands home, but kinship and shared enmity toward the Dark Irons sometimes bring travelers like Farsen to the ancestral Bronzebeard lands of Dun Morogh.

faq.q: What comes directly after completing Farsen's Watch?
faq.answer: After you witness the Dark Iron infiltration through Farsen's vision, he urges you to suppress the encroaching enemy with 'Nip 'Em in the Bud'.

angles.text: As a Bronzebeard defender, you hear warning from an Aerie Peak cousin, a sign of how brazen the Dark Iron infiltration of your homeland has become.
As a shaman, you see the earthen and spiritual vision of the Wildhammer tradition, rooted in the crags of Aerie Peak.
As an Alliance traveler, you help uncover Dark Iron plots in Dun Morogh and protect Ironforge and the surrounding mountain passes.
